This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the lowest temperature recorded by the Hong Kong Observatory in degrees Celsius on 8 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from the Hong Kong Observatory, specifically the "Absolute Daily Min (deg. C)" the specified date once information is finalized in the relevant "Daily Extract", available here: https://www.weather.gov.hk/en/cis/climat.htm

This market can not resolve until data for this date has been published.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures in Celsius to one decimal place (eg, 9.1°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Any revisions to temperatures recorded after data is initially published for this market's timeframe will not be considered for this market's resolution.

Traders heavily favor 28°C because historical climatology shows overnight lows averaging 26–28°C under similar ENSO-neutral to warm conditions, with recent seasonal outlooks from the Observatory indicating normal-to-above-normal temperatures overall. Key variables include steering patterns that sustain warm, moist air and any last-minute adjustments in numerical weather models, which could shift the exact minimum by 1°C before resolution.
